From: Paulo Ferreira <paulo.ferreira@gmail.com>
To: John Keller <john.keller@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 18:41 UTC
Subject: Ines & Tom wedding - Lisbon details + flights

Hey John!

So glad you're coming. Ceremony is Sat Oct 24 at 4pm at Quinta da Regaleira, reception and dinner after at the same place. Dress is cocktail, and the gardens get steep and gravelly, so flats are a good idea if you have them.

Ines and Tom are staying at the Hotel Avenida Palace, and we have a room block under Ferreira (rate ends Oct 15). It's about a 10 minute walk from the Restauradores metro stop. If you'd rather be closer to the venue, there are a few places in Sintra, but the shuttle is only running Saturday afternoon.

Let me know your flight times so I can make sure someone picks you up from the airport if you want. Lisbon airport is about 20 minutes from the hotel by taxi or the metro (red line to Baixa-Chiado, then walk).

Also, Ines asked me to remind you to bring a copy of your passport for the civil paperwork on Friday. Original not needed.

Can't wait to see you!

Paulo

--
Paulo Ferreira
+351 912 448 067
